# AWS Private CA certificate issuance

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend records-only certificate authorities with certificate signing so an authority can become ACTIVE and issue and revoke certificates.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] GetCertificateAuthorityCsr and ImportCertificateAuthorityCertificate with real key generation
- [ ] ACTIVE and DISABLED authorities, Serial, NotBefore and NotAfter
- [ ] IssueCertificate, GetCertificate, GetCertificateAuthorityCertificate and RevokeCertificate
- [ ] CRL generation and OCSP for enabled revocation settings
- [ ] Audit reports, permissions and resource policies
- [ ] CloudFormation CertificateAuthorityActivation and Certificate resources

## Integration decisions

The current Private CA API persists certificate authority records and tags only; no cryptography is performed.
